# MME Worldwide

> MME Worldwide (also known as MMEink and MME Ink Worldwide) is a full service
> event production and experiential marketing agency. Founded in 1995, with
> offices in New York City, Long Island, and Miami, MME partners with brands and
> agencies to design, fabricate, and produce live brand experiences under one
> production partner.

Contact: 1-877-885-0705 | info@mmeink.com
Headquarters: 140 Florida St, Farmingdale, NY 11735
Areas served: New York City, Long Island, Miami, New Jersey, Connecticut, nationwide, worldwide.

## What MME Worldwide does

MME provides an integrated approach that covers a project from initial creative
development through engineering, fabrication, logistics, installation, live
execution, and strike. Clients can engage a single service or the full stack.

## Services

- [Custom Fabrication](https://www.mmeink.com/services/custom-fabrication): Experiential activations, product launches, trade show exhibits, immersive environments, pop-ups, and branded installations, designed and built in house.
- [Large Format Printing and Branded Graphics](https://www.mmeink.com/services/printing): Large format printing, custom signage, dimensional graphics, step and repeats, backdrops, wall, window and floor graphics, banners, wayfinding, and exhibition graphics.
- [Audio Visual and Event Technology](https://www.mmeink.com/services/audio-visual): Sound systems, LED video walls, projection, presentation technology, live streaming, video conferencing, show calling, technical direction, and on site engineering.
- [Lighting Design and Production](https://www.mmeink.com/services/lighting): Architectural lighting, intelligent and moving lighting, LED systems, uplighting, stage and scenic lighting, pin spotting, gobo and logo projection, and atmospheric effects.
- [Staging and Scenic Production](https://www.mmeink.com/services/staging): Custom stages, branded stage sets, presentation platforms, runways, risers, LED integrated staging, backdrops, and scenic fabrication.
- [Creative Design and Décor](https://www.mmeink.com/services/design-decor): Event design, creative direction, custom décor, floral design, lounge environments, tablescapes, draping, dimensional branding, and immersive installations.
- [Corporate Event Themes and Immersive Experiences](https://www.mmeink.com/services/themes): Distinctive event themes brought to life through custom scenic design, immersive décor, specialty props, branded environments, lighting, furniture, floral design, entertainment, and custom fabrication.
- [Event Props and Immersive Environments](https://www.mmeink.com/services/props): Statement props, themed installations, oversized objects, photo moments, interactive installations, and custom built scenic elements.
- [Event Rentals](https://www.mmeink.com/services/rentals): Lounge furniture, sofas, chairs, tables, bars, cocktail tables, specialty seating, staging, linens, décor, backdrops, red carpets, stanchions, and lighting.
- [Musical Entertainment](https://www.mmeink.com/services/musical-entertainment): Live bands, DJs, vocalists, jazz ensembles, string quartets, pianists, orchestras, and custom musical productions, including booking and technical production.
- [Entertainment and Interactive Experiences](https://www.mmeink.com/services/entertainment): Specialty performers, aerialists, magicians, 360 degree video booths, AI powered photo experiences, casino and carnival experiences, arcade games, simulators, virtual reality, and team building.
- [Logistics, White Glove Services and Storage](https://www.mmeink.com/services/logistics): White glove delivery, dedicated trucking, freight coordination, receiving, inventory management, warehousing, packing and crating, installation, strike, and return logistics.
